notes.title: Demo alive! And some other updates on the project..
notes.notes: [p]Due to a potential ownership dispute, there will be a new version published on another page, where a demo is already available. [/p][p][/p][p]I am sorry for all the trouble and inconvenience caused by this and hope you will be enjoying that version in the new page.  In the meantime, I will be working on the version with the original, vanilla taste of the project.[/p]

notes.title: We are part of the Steam's Creature Collection Fest!
notes.notes:
After a long long time, we are finally closed to the demo phase, and hopefully we could get in Steam's Next Fest in June.

Thanks for all the waiting and wishlists, we wish we could deliver the demo build as hard as we can. 

Will announce the demo release later, stay tuned!
[previewyoutube=IFSeCmaQ2w0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Fantamon's New Accnouncement on @DevGamm!
notes.notes:
A breeze from the Baltic sea, Fantamon is announcing its birth now!

Wishlist us and stay tuned! The game is planned to be released in the end of 2025.

Thank you for all your pathient waiting, we will be there, we are long runners, we will get to the end!

notes.title: Enter the Dragon is Live!
notes.notes: Our livestream as part of Enter the Dragon is about to begin! We'll be streaming Fantamal for one hour over on the Enter the Dragon Steam event page, and we would love for you to join us. See you there!

notes.title: Chat with us on Discord
notes.notes:
We plan to host a chat session with you guys on 11AM, 18, June cst on Discord.

Ask any questions about the game, and we will be happy to answer.

Discord:
https://discord.gg/GPXhWuX

On a second thought, you already have the Discord link and won't be kicked off after the session, why don't you keep hanging out in our Discord and ask things anytime. We'll response when we see it. ;)

notes.title: New Schedule for Fantamal's Live-Stream Play Through
notes.notes:
The previous live stream date has been re-scheduled due to Game Festival's change-of-date.

Anyway, we'll go through the game briefly and explain how the game works, what mechanisms contained in the game and what the game will look like in the future. Along with some development plans.

After that, a chat session will be arranged on the next day or the other days. Stay tuned for more info.
